cases.why_sensitive: National identity number: a lifelong unique identifier usable for identity fraud and linkage across systems.
cases.root_cause: Label glued to the number ('NIC:<13 digits>'). spaCy keeps it as one token, so Presidio's context enhancer finds no preceding context word and the plain 13-digit pattern stays at 0.30, below the 0.35 threshold.
cases.risk: Full CNIC left in redacted output.
cases.proposed_fix: Label-anchored plain CNIC pattern (lookbehind on CNIC/NIC/National ID/NADRA ID/Identity No.), score 0.70.

cases.why_sensitive: Personal email: direct contact channel and a common login identifier.
cases.root_cause: Presidio's EmailRecognizer regex allows '=' in the local part, so in key=value text 'email=p.hussain@example.com' is matched as one address.
cases.risk: Low for redaction (over-redaction of the key) but wrong span; downstream parsers lose the key.
cases.proposed_fix: Span hygiene: drop a leading 'key=' from EMAIL_ADDRESS spans (both modes).
